audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields state that Bouncing Bomb 'out-ranges your Thundering Shuriken'. It does not: Ziggs' Q is 850 range, Kennen's Q is 950. The real reason he wins the chip war is the cooldown (6s falling to 4s versus 7s falling to 4s, with the bomb bouncing onward past its cast point), not raw range.
audit.why: Riot's data: Ziggs Q 850 range, 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s; Kennen Q 950 range. Telling the reader he is out-ranged makes him play further back than he needs to and gives up free last-hits.
audit.corrected: Ziggs chips more often because the bomb bounces past its 850 cast range on a 6-second timer — but the raw range advantage is Kennen's, so use it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five level rows disagree with the packet chart and with the matchup's own why text. Level 3 is Kennen although whys[2] says 'genuinely even'; Levels 4-5 are Kennen although whys[3] says you concede the engage window; Level 6 is Ziggs although whys[4] calls it the one all-in that beats him; First item is Kennen although whys[5] calls it an even race; 2+ items is Kennen although whys[6] and the late paragraph say Ziggs reclaims the lane for good.
audit.why: Level 6 is the single stage Kennen owns because Slicing Maelstrom out-damages anything Ziggs has before items, and it lines up against Satchel Charge's 20s rank-1 cooldown. Everything from two items on belongs to artillery range.
audit.corrected: Level 3 = Skill, Levels 4-5 = Ziggs, Level 6 = Kennen, First item = Skill, 2+ items = Ziggs.

audit.why: The spikes are right and unusually specific: Ziggs owns 1-3, Kennen's single window is level 6, first item is a race, and Ziggs takes it late. Worth noting Mega Inferno Bomb falls to 70s at rank 3 while Slicing Maelstrom stays a flat 120s.

edits.before: Ziggs' Q (Bouncing Bomb) out-ranges your Thundering Shuriken and bounces, so he chips you for free before you ever stack a Mark of the Storm — eat the minimum, last-hit with Q from max range, and do NOT walk up to auto with Electrical Surge or you'll take two bombs for one mark. You have no stun and a paper body here, so don't burn E chasing a single mark; you can't three-stack him before he just W-knocks you back and reloads. Save E entirely as a gap-closer for level 6, not as poke.
edits.after: Ziggs' Bouncing Bomb (Q) bounces past its 850 cast range and returns every 6 seconds, so he wins the chip war even though Thundering Shuriken reaches 950 — eat the minimum, last-hit from max range, and do NOT walk up to auto with Electrical Surge or you'll take two bombs for one mark. You have no stun and a paper body here, so don't burn E chasing a single mark; you can't three-stack him before Satchel Charge knocks you back. Save E entirely as a gap-closer for level 6, not as poke.

edits.before: Level 6 is your one real swing: when his W (Satchel) is on cooldown, E onto him, Q-W to slam Mark of the Storm to the third-stack stun, then Flash-R so Slicing Maelstrom stun-locks him through the burst. If you don't kill on that combo you lose — his minefield and Satchel reset the gap and you're back to eating Q poke with R down. Track his W cooldown religiously; if it's up he just knocks you out of the channel and walks away unscathed.

If you don't kill on that combo you lose — his minefield and Satchel reset the gap and you're back to eating Q poke with R down.
